en.text:
{{I am a multifaceted developer with [[2 years of experience]], and [[9 years of general development]] experience, specializing in tools, generic game systems, and backend development.}} This experience is mostly derived from working with {{C#}} in the {{Unity}} engine, and {{C++}} is various custom applications/engines. I have also had some professional experience as a fullstack developer in {{React}} and {{NodeJS}}.

{{I am driven by new challenges and learning opportunities}}, and I strive to find creative solutions to new problems, [[where needed]]. While I love coming up with new and unique solutions, I also know when to rely on [[stable existing solutions.]]

I build mental maps of every part of the code base that I contact. In my team I am always the person to ask how various parts of the codebase work, or why this bug is happening here. I take full [[responsibility]] of my work, but also make sure my teammates are able to navigate my code with very little hassle.
